Photograph of the white-border [[Hiding In The Garbage (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]], with a 1999 copyright line. The photographer is not identified. The complete obtained photograph is tightly framed; some outer white edges or corners lie at or beyond its frame. No missing border has been reconstructed.

== Source ==
* [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/sFcAAOSwpz9gtGKY/s-l1600.webp Complete source photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 x 1600-pixel photograph was resized with Lanczos resampling to 350 x 467 pixels and saved as PNG. Complete source frame retained. Printed words, art, icons and borders were not repainted, recolored or reconstructed. This is a photographic reproduction, not a facsimile. No added seller badge is visible in the obtained photograph. Acquisition and listing dates do not establish first publication.
